labels.title: Label
labels.$comment: label associated to the instance of the peripheral, can be overridden at sample level. In this case it becomes read-only.

init_type.title: resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: generate or not the XSPI init code, call it or not at boot
init_type.$comment: generate the init code of your XSPI or not (enabled/disabled), call it automatically at startup or not (called/enabled)

rw_recovery_time_cycle.title: Recovery time
rw_recovery_time_cycle.description: It indicates the number of cycles for the device recovery time. This parameter can be a value between 0 and 255

access_time_cycle.title: Access time
access_time_cycle.description: It indicates the number of cycles for the device access time. This parameter can be a value between 0 and 255

write_zero_latency.title: Write access zero latency
write_zero_latency.description: Enables zero latency on write operation

size_bit.title: XSPI memory size
size_bit.description: Defines the maximum size of the memory that you are using

cs_boundary.title: Chip select boundary
cs_boundary.description: Defines the granularity at which the chip select signal can be toggled

cs_high_time_cycle.title: Chip select high time
cs_high_time_cycle.description: Defines the minimum number of clock cycles during which the chip select must remain high between commands. This parameter can be a value between 1 and 64

cs_refresh_time.title: Chip select refresh time
cs_refresh_time.description: It enables the refresh rate feature. Choose the number of clock cycles after which the chip select signal will be released periodically. Applicable for RAM only. This parameter can be a value between 0 and 0xFFFFFFFF

cs_refresh_time_converted.title: Chip select refresh time conversion
cs_refresh_time_converted.description: This feature is applicable to RAM memory only

wrap_size_byte.title: Wrap size
wrap_size_byte.description: Defines wrap size if wrapped reads are supported by the memory

clock_source.title: Clock source
clock_source.description: Clock source can be modified in clock tree

clock_source_frequency.title: Clock source frequency
clock_source_frequency.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree

clk_prescaler.title: Clock prescaler
clk_prescaler.description: This prescaler divides the clock source frequency to get the final frequency on XSPI bus. This parameter can be a value between 1 and 255

clock_memory_frequency.title: Clock memory frequency
clock_memory_frequency.description: Clock frequency on XSPI bus. This is the frequency at which the memory will operate. It is equal to the input clock frequency divided by the clock prescaler

shift.title: Sample shifting
shift.description: Enable this option so that the sample of data is taken a full clock cycle after the data is driven by the external device, instead of half a clock cycle (default value). Applicable in SDR communication only

hold.title: Delay hold quarter cycle
hold.description: Add a quarter delay on the outputs in DTR communication to match hold requirement. Applicable in DTR communication only

SetFifoThreshold.title: FIFO Threshold
SetFifoThreshold.description: Choose the number of bytes in the FIFO that causes the FIFO threshold flag to be set

cssel.title: NCS select
cssel.description: Select if NCS is copied to NCS1 or NCS2

clock_polarity.title: Clock polarity
clock_polarity.description: Choose level of clock signal when clock is in IDLE state (when chip is not selected)

dlyb_state.title: Enable delay block
dlyb_state.description: Enable the delay block peripheral dedicated to your XSPI instance

oneOf.title: Sampling clock is delayed by the delay block

AutoEvaluateDelay.title: Automatic evaluation of delay block output clock phase
AutoEvaluateDelay.description: Generates code to automatically evaluate and set the output clock phase value of the delay block peripheral

actions.message: You must enable delay block to use this feature

SetConfigDelay.title: Manual set of delay block ouput clock phase
SetConfigDelay.description: If you already know the delay block output clock phase value, choose the value you want to set. Available only if  delay block is enable and automatic evaluation is disabled

delay_value_type.title: Calibration type
delay_value_type.description: Defines which calibration is concerned by the configuration. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter

oneOf.title: Full clock cycle
oneOf.description: Delay value equivalent to full memory-clock cycle

oneOf.title: Feedback clock
oneOf.description: Delay value for the feedback clock when reading without DQS

oneOf.title: Output data
oneOf.description: Delay value for output data in DDR mode for write operations

oneOf.title: DQS input
oneOf.description: Delay value for DQS input when sampling data for read operations

fine_cal_unit.title: Fine calibration value
fine_cal_unit.description: Defines the fine calibration value of the delay. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter. This parameter can be a value between 0 and 0x7F

coarse_cal_unit.title: Coarse calibration value
coarse_cal_unit.description: Defines the coarse calibration value of the delay. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter. This parameter can be a value between 0 and 0x1F

max_cal.title: Outside range calibration
max_cal.description: Defines if memory-clock period is inside or outside the range of DLL master. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter

cs_release_time_cycle.title: Maximum bytes transfer (Chip select release time)
cs_release_time_cycle.description: Enables the communication regulation feature. Choose the maximum number of bytes to transfer before the other XSPI request the access to the bus. This parameter can be a value between 0 and 255

EnableDMA_TX.title: DMA TX
EnableDMA_TX.description: Enable DMA TX mode for the peripheral.

EnableDMA_RX.title: DMA RX
EnableDMA_RX.description: Enable DMA RX mode for the peripheral.

EnableInterruption.title: Interruption
EnableInterruption.description: Enable interruption mode for the peripheral.

timeout_activation.title: Timeout Activation
timeout_activation.description: Defines if the timeout counter is enabled to release the chip select

timeout_period.title: Timeout period
timeout_period.description: Specifies the number of clock cycles to wait when the FIFO is full before to release the chip select. This parameter can be any value between 0 and 0xFFFF

timeout_period_converted.title: Timeout period conversion
timeout_period_converted.description: Specifies the number of clock cycles to wait when the FIFO is full before to release the chip select. This parameter can be any value between 0 and 0xFFFF

EnableSIOO.title: SIOO
EnableSIOO.description: By default, Send Instruction Only Once mode is enabled. You can disable it for debug purpose

prefetch_data.title: Prefetch data
prefetch_data.description: By default data prefetch is enabled. You can disable it for debug purpose

prefetch_axi.title: Prefetch AXI
prefetch_axi.description: By default AXI prefetch is enabled. You can disable it for debug purpose
